map.估算光伏系统发电量和收益: Estimate the PV system's generation and revenue
map.📖 查看「太阳能发电计算 使用指南」: 📖 View the "Solar Power Generation Calculation User Guide"
map.光伏发电与收益估算（本页代码口径，按峰值日照小时）：日发电量=装机功率 P(W): PV generation and revenue estimate (as implemented on this page, by peak sun hours): daily generation = installed power P (W) × peak sun hours × system efficiency ÷ 1000 (kWh); peak sun hours follow the city selection and default to 4.0 h — the area input is for record display only and does not affect generation; monthly/annual generation = daily × 30/× 365; annual revenue = annual generation × (tariff + subsidy); installation cost = P × 8 (at 8 CNY/W); payback = cost ÷ annual revenue; 25-year total generation reduction is converted at 0.581 kg CO₂/kWh, with the monthly distribution multiplied by a seasonal factor and then × 0.85. Validation: power ≤ 0 prompts "Please enter the power first" and stops. Criteria: no fixed grading; revenue rises linearly with tariff and subsidy.

map.月用电 600 kWh 家庭光伏测算: Household PV estimation for 600 kWh monthly electricity use
map.月用电 600 kWh（年约 7200 kWh）、输入功率 5500 W（5.5: Monthly consumption 600 kWh (about 7200 kWh/year), input power 5500 W (5.5 kWp), peak sun hours 4.0 h, system efficiency 80%, tariff 0.4 CNY/kWh, no subsidy: daily generation = 5.5×4.0×0.8 ≈ 17.6 kWh, annual generation ≈ 6424 kWh, covering about 89% of consumption; at 8 CNY/W the initial cost is about 44,000 CNY, annual income about 2,570 CNY, payback about 17.1 years. At 5.5 peak sun hours, annual generation rises to about 8833 kWh and payback shortens to about 12.5 years. Tip: subsidies or higher tariffs shorten payback.
map.自发自用和余电上网哪种收益高？: Which yields more, self-consumption or surplus feed-in?
map.自发自用节省零售电价，通常高于上网电价，因此提升自用率（加储能、错峰用电）收益更: Self-consumption saves the retail electricity price, usually higher than the feed-in tariff, so raising the self-use rate (adding storage, shifting usage off-peak) yields better returns; feed-in serves only to dispose of surplus power.
map.回收期受哪些因素影响最大？: Which factors most affect the payback period?
map.当地辐照、自用比例、初始投资单价与电价/补贴政策；辐照高且自用率高时回收期显著缩: Local irradiation, self-use ratio, initial investment unit price and electricity price/subsidy policy; with high irradiation and a high self-use ratio the payback period shortens notably.
